stanza: Warm
So warm
Screaming in the field
As I was born

field.songTitle: Wish You Were Here (Live at Rose Garden Arena, Portland, Oregon, 27th June 2000)
field.line: Can you tell a green field
stanza: So, so you think you can tell
Heaven from Hell
Blue skys from pain
Can you tell a green field
From a cold steel rail?
A smile from a veil?
Do you think you can tell?

field.line: From Thibodaux to Raceland there's fire in the fields
stanza: From Thibodaux to Raceland there's fire in the fields
All the way up the bayou from Lafourche to Iberville
Dirty air, dirty laundry, dirty money, dirty rain
A dirty dark at daybreak burning the sugar cane

field.line: But now a freeway covers the field
stanza: Once I was caught playing hooky from school
They found me home in the evening
I confessed I'd been to the movie show
When I was a boy in Ohio
We would wait for the summer to come
For swimmin' and pickin' berries
But now a freeway covers the field
Where I used to be so happy

field.songTitle: The Coast No Man Can Tell
field.line: Until that day we walk through the fields
field.linePrev: As I hope I will in yours
field.lineNext: When all of God's promises are fulfilled

field.line: I meant to ask you how to plow that field
stanza: Gone now is the day and gone the sun
There is peace tonight all over Arlington
But the song of my life will still be sung
By the light of the moon you hung
I meant to ask you how to plow that field
I meant to bring you water from the well
And be the one beside you when you fell
Could you tell?
On the black road
Through the gold fields
While the fields are plowed
Towards what we are allowed..

field.line: Runnin' through the parking lot, runnin' through the fields
stanza: Runnin' through the parking lot, runnin' through the fields
Policemen on my back, somethin' hit my skull and cracked
They dragged me off to jail, set a million dollar bail
Where I tried to tie a noose, but I failed and I broke loose
I went racing through the prison yard, shot down by a tower guard
He got me in the shins and he got me in the arms
They strapped me in the gurney, took me off to the infirmary
Where the priest read my last rites
And just before everythin' went dark, I said

field.line: Rising above the factories and the fields
stanza: There's a place out on the edge of town, sir
Rising above the factories and the fields
Now, ever since I was a child, I can remember
That mansion on the hill
(Right...) It's halftime
(Right...) Exhale, check it, it's halftime
(Right...) It's halftime
(Right...) It's real in the field
Word life, check it
Clover blooms in the fields
Spring breaks loose, the time is near
What would he do if he found us out?
Crescent moon, coast is clear
Spring breaks loose, but so does fear
He's gonna burn this house to the ground
How's one to know?
I'd live and die for moments that we stole
On begged and borrowed time
So tell me to run
Or dare to sit and watch what we'll become
And drink my husband's wine

field.line: The final track on Griffin’s 2015 album Servant of Love, “Shine a Different Way…
stanza: The final track on Griffin’s 2015 album Servant of Love, “Shine a Different Way…
The one that rain forgot
I'm gonna let it be the summer
I'm gonna let it be your face
The one that ran away
I'm gonna let it be forever
I'm gonna let it rain and hail
Let the rusty nail
No longer hold this world together

shield.line: I looked up and saw Orion wielding a club and a shield
stanza: When I was leaning on Skrillex's tour bus waiting for the hotel shuttle in the…
I barely knew who I was
I looked up and saw Orion wielding a club and a shield
And there you were again:
Majestic dead wife
As my grief becomes calcified, frozen in stories
And in these songs I keep singing, numbing it down
The unsingable real memories of you
And the feral eruptions of sobbing

yield.line: And wondered what your life would yield
stanza: Your daddy was a farmer
His back was burnished red and gold
And every time he closed his eyes a rooster crowed
He sowed a hundred rows of corn
The summer you were born
And wondered what your life would yield
